description: 对话练习：Story time + Cartoon time 完整内容，角色扮演跟读

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: Yesterday was 21st October.
lines.chinese: 昨天是10月21日。

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: It was Grandma's 66th birthday.
lines.chinese: 那天是奶奶的66岁生日。

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: Wang Bing and his parents went to their grandparents' house.
lines.chinese: 王兵和他的父母去了爷爷奶奶家。

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: His parents gave Grandma a nice smartphone.
lines.chinese: 他的父母送给奶奶一部漂亮的智能手机。

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: Wang Bing drew a picture for her.
lines.chinese: 王兵为她画了一幅画。

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: They also brought a big birthday cake.
lines.chinese: 他们还带了一个大生日蛋糕。

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: Grandpa and Grandma were so happy to see them.
lines.chinese: 爷爷奶奶看到他们非常开心。

lines.speaker: Wang Bing
lines.english: We had a big lunch. We ate noodles and wished Grandma a long life.
lines.chinese: 我们吃了一顿丰盛的午餐。我们吃了面条，祝奶奶长寿。

lines.speaker: Wang Bing
lines.english: Then Grandma blew out the candles, and we ate the cake.
lines.chinese: 然后奶奶吹灭了蜡烛，我们吃了蛋糕。

lines.speaker: Wang Bing
lines.english: In the afternoon, I chatted with Grandma.
lines.chinese: 下午，我和奶奶聊天。

lines.speaker: Wang Bing
lines.english: We also took a family photo. It was our 12th family photo.
lines.chinese: 我们还拍了一张全家福。那是我们的第12张全家福。

lines.speaker: Wang Bing
lines.english: When I was a little kid, Grandpa and Grandma took care of me.
lines.chinese: 当我还是个小孩的时候，爷爷奶奶照顾我。

lines.speaker: Wang Bing
lines.english: Now I am a big boy. I can take care of them. I want to spend more time with them.
lines.chinese: 现在我是个大男孩了。我可以照顾他们。我想多陪陪他们。

sections.title: Cartoon time — The Double Ninth Festival

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: It is the Double Ninth Festival today.
lines.chinese: 今天是重阳节。

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: What is the Double Ninth Festival, Tina?
lines.chinese: Tina，重阳节是什么节日呀？

lines.speaker: Tina
lines.english: It's a day for old people.
lines.chinese: 这是老年人的节日。

lines.speaker: Tina
lines.english: It's on the ninth day of the ninth lunar month.
lines.chinese: 它在农历九月初九。

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: What do people do on this day?
lines.chinese: 人们在这一天做什么呢？

lines.speaker: Tina
lines.english: They show their love for their grandmothers and grandfathers.
lines.chinese: 他们表达对爷爷奶奶的爱。

lines.speaker: Tina
lines.english: They give them gifts and do chores for them.
lines.chinese: 他们给他们送礼物，为他们做家务。

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: What should we do for Grandpa?
lines.chinese: 我们应该为爷爷做什么呢？

lines.speaker: Tina
lines.english: We can cook dinner for him.
lines.chinese: 我们可以给他做晚饭。

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: Good idea! We can make a card for him too.
lines.chinese: 好主意！我们也可以给他做一张卡片。

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: In the afternoon, Bobby, Tina and their parents went to see Grandpa.
lines.chinese: 下午，Bobby、Tina和他们的父母去看望爷爷。

lines.speaker: Bobby & Tina
lines.english: Happy Double Ninth Festival, Grandpa! We love you!
lines.chinese: 爷爷，重阳节快乐！我们爱您！

lines.speaker: Grandpa
lines.english: Thank you! I love you too!
lines.chinese: 谢谢！我也爱你们！

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: The Double Ninth Festival is a time to show love for the elderly.
lines.chinese: 重阳节是向长辈表达关爱的日子。
